senses.title: Image and signal reconstruction
senses.titleCN: 图像重建：由探测数据还原画面
senses.definition: in imaging and signal processing, the computation that turns raw detector measurements into a readable image
senses.definitionCN: 在成像与信号处理中，把探测器原始测量换算成可读图像的计算过程
senses.example: Image reconstruction turns detector signals into a readable CT scan.
senses.exampleCN: 图像重建把探测器信号变成可读的 CT 扫描图。
senses.why: Here reconstruction is mathematical: the object is not physically rebuilt, only recovered from data.
senses.whyCN: 这里的重建是数学性的：物体并未被物理重建，只是从数据中被还原出来。

senses.title: Memory reconstruction
senses.titleCN: 记忆重构：回忆是对过去的再拼装
senses.definition: in psychology, the view that remembering is an active rebuilding of past experience rather than a faithful replay
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中认为记忆是对过去经验的主动重建，而非忠实回放的观点
senses.example: Memory is partly a reconstruction, not a faithful recording.
senses.exampleCN: 记忆在某种程度上是重构，而不是忠实录音。
senses.why: Psychology borrowed the building metaphor for the mind: recall selects and reassembles fragments, and the result may differ from the original.
senses.whyCN: 心理学把建筑隐喻借给心智：回忆挑选并重新拼合碎片，其结果可能与原初不同。

senses.title: The American Reconstruction era
senses.titleCN: 美国重建时期：南北战争后的政治阶段
senses.definition: in United States history, the period after the Civil War when the Union rebuilt the South's politics and society
senses.definitionCN: 美国历史中指南北战争后联邦重建南方政治与社会的时期
senses.example: The Reconstruction era left a long mark on voting rights.
senses.exampleCN: 重建时期在投票权问题上留下了长久印记。
senses.why: The proper noun applies the general word to a whole national project, and the capital R marks it as a named historical period.
senses.whyCN: 这个专有名词把一般词用于一项全国工程，大写 R 标明它是有名称的历史时期。

intro.en: Reconstruction is re- plus construction, and construction comes from Latin construere 'to pile up, build'. The word is an English formation on Latin materials rather than a direct Latin borrowing.
intro.cn: reconstruction 是 re- 加 construction，而 construction 出自拉丁 construere「堆积、建造」。该词是用拉丁材料在英语中构成的，并非直接借自拉丁。

items.en: Latin struere meant 'to pile up, build, arrange'. Its compounds include construere 'to build together' and destructure 'to tear down'.
items.cn: 拉丁 struere 意为「堆积、建造、安排」，其复合词包括 construere「一起建造」与 destructure「拆毁」。

items.en: Construere joined com- 'together' to struere, giving the image of materials piled into one structure; English construct comes from it.
items.cn: construere 把 com-「一起」加到 struere 上，形成「材料堆成一个结构」的意象；英语 construct 由此而来。

items.en: The prefix re- means 'again' or 'back'. Added to construction, it marks a second building of what already existed or was destroyed.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 意为「再次」或「回」。加到 construction 上，它标记对已存在或被毁之物进行第二次建造。

items.en: Reconstruction appears in English by the late eighteenth century; the exact first citation is uncertain.
items.cn: reconstruction 于 18 世纪晚期出现在英语中；最早确切书证存疑。

items.en: The nineteenth and twentieth centuries extended it to linguistic reconstruction, memory reconstruction and computed image reconstruction.
items.cn: 19 与 20 世纪把它扩展到语言构拟、记忆重构与计算图像重建。

items.en: The precise date of first English use and the earliest sense (physical rebuilding or figurative recovery) are uncertain.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代与最早义项）：英语首用确切年代以及最早义项（实体重建还是比喻性复原）均存疑。

note.en: The first group separates parts of the construct family; the second gives near-synonyms that stress restoring, recreating or remaking.
note.cn: 第一组区分 construct 词族的不同形式；第二组给出强调修复、再现或重制的近义词。

entries.definition: The original act of building. Reconstruction adds the idea of a second time after damage.
entries.definitionCN: 指最初的建造行为。reconstruction 增加了「受损后再来一次」的意思。

entries.definition: The verb 'to build', or a noun for an idea assembled from parts. It does not imply rebuilding.
entries.definitionCN: 动词「建造」，或指由部分拼合的观念；不含「重建」义。

entries.definition: To build again or piece together; reconstruction is the act or its result.
entries.definitionCN: 指重建或拼合；reconstruction 是动作或其结果。

entries.definition: Describing surgery or work that rebuilds a part; it modifies a noun rather than naming the process.
entries.definitionCN: 形容重建某部位的手术或工作；修饰名词，不命名过程本身。

entries.definition: Bringing something back to a former condition, often with fidelity to the original. Reconstruction may use new materials.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物恢复到从前的状态，常强调忠于原貌；reconstruction 可以使用新材料。

entries.definition: The everyday word for building again. It is narrower and rarely used for ideas or data.
entries.definitionCN: 日常用语，指再次建造；范围较窄，很少用于观念或数据。

entries.definition: Can mean the act of creating again, but usually means leisure activity. Context decides, and it is not a synonym for reconstruction.
entries.definitionCN: 可指再次创造，但通常指休闲活动；由语境决定，并非 reconstruction 的同义词。

entries.definition: The process of getting something back or returning to health. It stresses the return, not the rebuilding work.
entries.definitionCN: 指取回某物或恢复健康的过程，强调「回来」，而非重建工作。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- 'again' + construct 'pile up' + -ion: piling the same structure up again.
normal.cn: re-「再次」+ construct「堆起」+ -ion：把同一结构再堆一次。

normal.en: The family runs construct, construction, reconstruct, reconstructive, structure.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 construct、construction、reconstruct、reconstructive、structure。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: post-war reconstruction, linguistic reconstruction, image reconstruction, memory reconstruction.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：战后重建、语言构拟、图像重建、记忆重构。

normal.en: A reconstruction can be physical, evidentiary, linguistic, surgical or computational.
normal.cn: 重建可以是实体的、证据性的、语言的、手术的或计算的。

normal.en: The capital-R Reconstruction names a US historical period, not any ordinary rebuilding.
normal.cn: 大写 Reconstruction 指美国一个历史时期，而非任何普通重建。

abstract.en: Picture numbered fragments of an arch laid out on the floor, waiting to be fitted back together.
abstract.cn: 想象拱门的编号碎片摊在地上，等待被重新拼合。

abstract.en: Picture a detective arranging photographs on a board until the order of events appears.
abstract.cn: 想象侦探在板上排列照片，直到事件顺序浮现。

abstract.en: Picture a scanner circling a body and a computer drawing the inside from echoes.
abstract.cn: 想象扫描仪绕着人体旋转，计算机据回声画出内部。

examples.en: The reconstruction of the cathedral used stone from the original quarry.
examples.cn: 大教堂的重建使用了原采石场的石料。

examples.en: Historians' reconstruction of the battle depends on letters from both sides.
examples.cn: 历史学家对这场战役的还原依赖双方的来信。

examples.en: Memory reconstruction can add details that were never present.
examples.cn: 记忆重构可能加入从未存在过的细节。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）+ construction（建造）」——再建一遍 → reconstruction 重建、复原

root: 拉丁 struere「堆积、建造」→ construere「一起建造」→ 英语 construct / construction；加 re-「再次」与 -ion 构成 reconstruction。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses rebuild different things: a bridge, an event, a lost language, a nation, a body, an image, a memory, and a historical era.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项重建的对象各不相同：一座桥、一起事件、一门失传语言、一个国家、一具身体、一幅图像、一段记忆，以及一个历史时期。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: numbered fragments of an arch fitted back into one structure.
core.cn: 核心意象：带编号的拱门碎片被重新拼成一个结构。

branches.en: STONE AND EVENTS: either a physical structure or a sequence of happenings is put back together.
branches.cn: 石头与事件：或是一个实体结构，或是一串发生之事被重新拼合。

branches.en: LOST LANGUAGE: fragments of descendants constrain the inferred ancestor.
branches.cn: 失传语言：后代语言的碎片约束对祖语的推断。

branches.en: NATION: a whole society is rebuilt, whether as a general project or a named era.
branches.cn: 国家：整个社会被重建，或作为一般工程，或作为有名称的时代。

branches.en: BODY: surgery rebuilds a damaged part rather than merely patching its surface.
branches.cn: 身体：手术重建受损部位，而不只是修补表面。

branches.en: DATA AND MIND: computation or recall reassembles a whole from fragments, without physical rebuilding.
branches.cn: 数据与心智：计算或回忆由碎片重组整体，并无物理重建。

intro.en: Reconstruction stacks three layers: the Latin verb struere 'pile up', the English noun construction, and the prefix re- 'again' plus -ion.
intro.cn: reconstruction 叠了三层：拉丁动词 struere「堆积」、英语名词 construction，再加前缀 re-「再次」与 -ion。

latinIntro.en: The struere family includes structure, construct, construction, destruct, instruct, obstruct and instrument, all built on the image of piling or arranging materials.
latinIntro.cn: struere 词族包括 structure、construct、construction、destruct、instruct、obstruct、instrument，都建立在堆积或安排材料的意象上。

items.meaning: the act or result of building again
items.example: The reconstruction of the school finished ahead of schedule.

items.meaning: to build again or piece together
items.example: Engineers reconstructed the failed joint in a test rig.
items.exampleCN: 工程师在试验台上重建了失效的接点。

items.meaning: the act of building; a structure
items.example: Construction of the tunnel began in spring.
items.exampleCN: 隧道的建造在春季开始。

items.example: They constructed a model from cardboard.
items.exampleCN: 他们用纸板搭了一个模型。

items.meaning: an arranged whole; the arrangement itself
to build knowledge into someone; to teach
items.meaningCN: 把知识建构进某人；教导
items.example: The manual instructs users to oil the hinge.
items.exampleCN: 手册指导用户给铰链上油。

items.meaning: to build in the way; to block

items.example: The command destructs the old archive.

definition_zh: 记录；最高纪录；唱片；录制；档案
definition_en: a written or stored account; the best result achieved; a disc of music; to set down or capture for later use
core_image: 厚厚的登记簿上，一行行墨迹整齐排列
scene: 田径场上计时牌停在新的世界最好成绩，看台上掌声四起。She broke the world record in the final race.
sceneCN: 这里 record 是「最高纪录」（第 2 个义项：已达成的最好成绩）；句意为她在决赛中打破了世界纪录。画面里可留意：停住的计时牌、看台上的掌声。

pos.zh: 记录；最高纪录；唱片；档案

senses.title: A stored account
senses.definition: a written or stored account of facts, events, or data
senses.definitionCN: 对事实、事件或数据的书面或电子留存
senses.example: The school keeps a record of every student.
senses.exampleCN: 学校保存着每名学生的记录。
senses.why: Recordari meant to bring something back to the heart, that is, to remember, and a record is memory made durable.
senses.whyCN: recordari 意为把某事重新放回心里，也就是记住，而记录就是被固定下来的记忆。

senses.title: The best result achieved
senses.definition: the best performance or result ever reached in a sport or activity
senses.definitionCN: 某项运动或活动中曾达到的最好成绩
senses.example: She broke the world record in the final race.
senses.exampleCN: 她在决赛中打破了世界纪录。
senses.why: A record once meant the line that holds the best result, and the word came to name the best result itself.
senses.whyCN: record 原指记载最好成绩的那一行，后来直接指最好成绩本身。

senses.title: A disc of music
senses.definition: a flat disc on which music or sound is stored
senses.definitionCN: 储存音乐或声音的扁平圆盘
senses.example: He still owns an old jazz record.
senses.exampleCN: 他还留着一张老爵士唱片。
senses.why: Music cut into a disc is a record in the physical sense, because the grooves store the sound.
senses.whyCN: 刻进圆盘的音乐是物理意义上的记录，因为沟槽储存着声音。

senses.title: To capture for later use
senses.definition: to store sound, images, or data so that they can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把声音、图像或数据储存起来供以后使用
senses.example: They recorded the concert for the archive.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为档案馆录制了这场音乐会。
senses.why: To record is to set something down for later recall, and a machine now performs that setting down.
senses.whyCN: 录制就是把某物记下以备日后回想，如今由机器来完成这一「记下」。

senses.title: An official file
senses.definition: the body of written evidence kept by a court, an office, or an institution
senses.definitionCN: 由法院、机关或机构保存的书面证据集合
senses.example: The court record shows two earlier warnings.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭档案显示此前有两次警告。
senses.why: An official file is a record kept by an institution, and the word widened from a single note to a body of evidence.
senses.whyCN: 官方档案是机构保存的记录，这个词从单条笔记扩展为一整套证据。

intro.en: Record begins at the heart: to remember is to bring a thing back to the heart, and to record is to fix that memory outside the body.
intro.cn: record 始于「心」：记住就是把事物放回心里，而记录则是把这份记忆固定在身体之外。

items.en: Cor, cordis meant heart, the seat of memory in older thought.
items.cn: cor、cordis 意为心，在更早的观念里是记忆所在之处。

items.en: Recordari meant to remember, literally to bring back to the heart.
items.cn: recordari 意为记住，字面就是「重新带回心里」。

items.en: Old French recorder carried both remembering and setting down in writing.
items.cn: 古法语 recorder 同时带有「记住」与「写下」的意思。

items.en: Middle English record named a witness, a written note, and the act of noting.
items.cn: 中古英语 record 指证人、书面笔录，以及记录的行为。

items.en: Modern English added the disc, the machine recording, and the sports best.
items.cn: 现代英语又加入了唱片、机器录制与运动最高成绩。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same cord- core; the near-meaning group gathers words for stored information and discs.
note.cn: 形近组收同样带 cord- 核心的词；近义组收表储存信息与唱片的词。

entries.definition: To tell a story in detail.
An agreement between parties.
Disagreement and conflict.
A written record of something.
An official list or record.
A regular written record of events.
A flat round object that stores sound.

normalIntro.en: The word is about memory kept outside the mind: a note, a disc, a file, a best score.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词讲的是存放在头脑之外的记忆：笔记、唱片、档案、最好成绩。

normal.en: Re plus cord: bring it back to the heart, and you remember; write it down, and you record.
normal.cn: re 加 cord：带回心里是记住，写下来就是记录。

normal.en: The noun stress is on the first syllable, the verb stress on the second.
normal.cn: 名词重音在第一音节，动词重音在第二音节。

normal.en: Break a record means to do better than anyone before.
normal.cn: break a record 意为超过此前所有人。

normal.en: On record means officially written down and known.
normal.cn: on record 意为有正式记载。

normal.en: Record a song and keep a record use the same word in two directions.
normal.cn: record a song 与 keep a record 是同一个词的两种方向。

abstract.en: A record is a promise made to the future that this moment happened.
abstract.cn: 记录是对未来作出的承诺：这一刻确实发生过。

abstract.en: What a culture records is what it intends to remember.
abstract.cn: 一个文化记录什么，就是它打算记住什么。

abstract.en: Every record will fall; the keeping of it is what lasts longer.
abstract.cn: 每一项纪录都会被打败，而记录它的行为持续得更久。

examples.en: The school keeps a record of every student.
examples.cn: 学校保存着每名学生的记录。

examples.en: She broke the world record in the final race.
examples.cn: 她在决赛中打破了世界纪录。

examples.en: They recorded the concert for the archive.
examples.cn: 他们为档案馆录制了这场音乐会。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）加 cord（心）：把事重新放回心里，就是记住；写下来留存，就是记录。

root: 拉丁 cor / cord-（心）→ recordari（回想，把事放回心里）→ 古法语 recorder → 中古英语 record → 英语 record；同族有 recorder、recording。

sensesIntro.en: The core is memory fixed outside the mind; the senses move from a written account to a best result, a disc, an act of capture, and an official file.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「固定在头脑之外的记忆」；义项从书面记录，到最好成绩、唱片、录制行为，再到官方档案。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick ledger filled with even lines of ink.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本厚厚的登记簿，一行行墨迹排列整齐。

branches.en: a ledger open on a desk
branches.cn: 桌上摊开的登记簿

branches.en: a scoreboard frozen at a new best
branches.cn: 停在最好成绩的计分牌

branches.en: a disc spinning on a turntable
branches.cn: 唱机上旋转的唱片

branches.en: a microphone capturing a concert
branches.cn: 捕捉音乐会的麦克风

branches.en: a file drawer marked official
branches.cn: 标着「官方」的档案抽屉

intro.en: The word joins the Latin word for heart to a prefix of return, and then spreads to discs, machines, and files.
intro.cn: 这个词把拉丁语的「心」与表回返的前缀结合，再扩展到唱片、机器与档案。

latinIntro.en: Its Latin base is cor, heart, and recordari, to remember; the prefix re- carries the sense of return.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 cor（心）与 recordari（记住）；前缀 re- 带有「回返」之义。

definition_zh: 求助；依靠；追索权
definition_en: the act of turning to something for help, or the legal right to demand payment
core_image: 一条路走到尽头，行人折回去敲响那扇唯一还亮着灯的窗
scene: 账上已经没有现金，公司只好回头向银行求助。Without cash, the firm had recourse to its bank.
sceneCN: 这里 recourse 指求助、诉诸（第 1 个义项：把某物当作求助的对象）；句意为账上已经没有现金，公司只好向银行求助。

senses.title: To have recourse to help
senses.definition: to turn to something or someone as a means of help
senses.definitionCN: 把某物或某人当作求助的手段
senses.example: Without cash, the firm had recourse to its bank.
senses.exampleCN: 账上已经没有现金，公司只好向银行求助。
senses.why: The first sense is active: someone chooses to turn back for help.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是主动的：有人选择折回去寻求帮助。

senses.title: A right of recourse
senses.definition: the legal right to demand payment from a guarantor or from the goods sold
senses.definitionCN: 向保证人或者已售货物要求清偿的法定权利
senses.example: The contract kept a right of recourse against the guarantor.
senses.exampleCN: 合同保留了对保证人的追索权。
senses.why: Law turns the turning-back into an enforceable claim.
senses.whyCN: 法律把「折回去」变成一项可以强制执行的请求权。

senses.title: A last recourse
senses.definition: the final source of help when every other option has failed
senses.definitionCN: 其他办法都用尽之后最后可依仗的东西
senses.example: Surgery was the last recourse after the drugs failed.
senses.exampleCN: 药物失效之后，手术成了最后的办法。
senses.why: Here recourse names the thing itself, not the act of turning to it.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项指所依靠的东西本身，而不是求助的动作。

intro.en: Recourse comes from Latin recursus, 'a running back', from recurrere, 'to run back'.
intro.cn: recourse 来自拉丁语 recursus（跑回去），源头是 recurrere（跑回）。

items.en: Currere meant to run.
items.cn: currere 意为跑。

items.en: Recurrere meant to run back, to return.
items.cn: recurrere 意为跑回去、返回。

items.en: The noun named a running back to a source.
items.cn: 这个名词指跑回源头。

items.en: English law made it a right to demand payment.
items.cn: 英国法律把它变成要求清偿的权利。

items.en: Today it means any source of help in difficulty.
items.cn: 今天它指困境中可以依靠的任何东西。

note.en: The look-alike group is the curr- family; the near-meaning group separates resort, appeal, refuge and expedient.
note.cn: 形近组是 curr 词族；近义组把「求助对象」「上诉」「避难所」「权宜手段」分开。

entries.definition: to happen again.
happening again and again.
a process that calls itself.
written with joined letters.
a place or course turned to for help.
entries.definitionCN: 求助时转向的地方或途径。

entries.definition: a request for a decision or help.
a shelter from danger.
a practical means used for a purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 为达到目的的实用手段。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a road ending and a traveller running back to the one lit window.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「路走到尽头，行人跑回那扇唯一亮着灯的窗」的画面。

normal.en: Recourse is a running back: re plus the course you ran.
normal.cn: recourse 是跑回去：re 加上你跑过的那条路。

normal.en: Picture the road ending and one window still lit.
normal.cn: 想象路到了尽头，只有一扇窗还亮着。

normal.en: Say rih-KORSS; the sound is a short, firm turn.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KORSS，声音短促而坚决，像一次折返。

normal.en: Legally, recourse is the turn that can be enforced.
normal.cn: 在法律上，recourse 是可以强制执行的那次折返。

normal.en: The word implies that ordinary means have failed.
normal.cn: 这个词意味着寻常办法已经行不通了。

abstract.en: Recourse is what a person does when the map runs out.
abstract.cn: 求助是地图用尽之后人所做的事。

abstract.en: Every right of recourse assumes someone else can be made to pay.
abstract.cn: 每一项追索权都预设可以把代价推给别人。

abstract.en: A last recourse is the hope that remains after planning stops.
abstract.cn: 最后的办法是计划停止之后仍然留下的那份指望。

examples.en: Without cash, the firm had recourse to its bank.
examples.cn: 账上已经没有现金，公司只好向银行求助。

examples.en: The contract kept a right of recourse against the guarantor.
examples.cn: 合同保留了对保证人的追索权。

examples.en: Surgery was the last recourse after the drugs failed.
examples.cn: 药物失效之后，手术成了最后的办法。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ course（跑、路线）→ 路走不通了就跑回去找那扇还亮着的窗。

root: 拉丁语 recurrere（跑回）→ re- + currere（跑）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses follow the same turn: the act of seeking help, the legal right to claim, and the last thing left to rely on.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项沿着同一次折返：寻求帮助的动作、可以主张的法律权利，以及最后能依靠的东西。

core.en: THE ROAD TURNS BACK TO HELP
core.cn: 折回求救的那条路

branches.en: Turning to a person or thing for aid.
branches.cn: 转向某人某物以求援助。

branches.en: The same turn written into a contract.
branches.cn: 同一次折返被写进合同。

branches.en: The final object on which hope rests.
branches.cn: 希望所寄托的最后一件东西。

branches.en: Practice and law share one verb of returning.
branches.cn: 实践与法律共享同一个「返回」的动词。

branches.en: Both are what remains when other means fail.
branches.cn: 两者都是其他办法失效后剩下来的东西。

intro.en: The curr- family is about running: recur means run back again, and recourse is the noun of that run.
intro.cn: curr 词族讲的是跑：recur 是再跑回来，recourse 是这次跑回来的名词形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin currere, 'to run', gives recurrere, 'to run back'; recourse keeps the noun recursus, a running back for aid.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）生出 recurrere（跑回）；recourse 保留了名词 recursus，即跑回去求援。

items.meaning: to run back, to happen again
a return of the same event
a running out on a trip

definition_zh: 康复；恢复；找回；追回；镇定下来
definition_en: to become healthy again; to return to a former condition; to get back something lost; to regain control of oneself
core_image: 病床上的人扶着床沿，第一次站起来
scene: 病床上的病人扶着床沿，慢慢把脚放到地上。He slowly recovered from the operation.
sceneCN: 这里 recovered 是「康复」（第 1 个义项：恢复健康）；句意为他在手术后慢慢康复。画面里可留意：扶住床沿的手、落到地上的脚。

senses.title: To become healthy again
senses.definition: to return to health after an illness or an operation
senses.definitionCN: 在生病或手术后恢复健康
senses.example: He slowly recovered from the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 他在手术后慢慢康复。
senses.why: The word pictures getting something back, and in illness what is got back is the body's former strength.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描绘「把东西取回」，而在疾病中取回的，是身体原有的力气。

senses.title: To return to a former condition
senses.definition: to return to an earlier good state after a fall or a shock
senses.definitionCN: 在下滑或冲击之后回到先前较好的状态
senses.example: The economy recovered quickly after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴过后经济迅速恢复。
senses.why: Health, markets, and nations all move away from a good state and then return, so one verb covers every return.
senses.whyCN: 身体、市场与国家都会离开良好状态再回来，因此同一个动词涵盖所有「回来」。

senses.title: To get back something lost
senses.definition: to find or obtain again something that was lost or taken away
senses.definitionCN: 重新找到或取得失去或被拿走的东西
senses.example: She recovered her lost keys from the sofa.
senses.exampleCN: 她从沙发里找回了丢失的钥匙。
senses.why: The oldest sense is to regain possession, and the body recovering health is a special case of getting something back.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是重新获得，而身体恢复健康正是「取回某物」的一个特例。

senses.title: To regain money or losses
senses.definition: to win back money, costs, or losses that had been lost
senses.definitionCN: 把失去的钱、成本或损失重新赢回来
senses.example: The company recovered most of its losses.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司追回了大部分损失。
senses.why: In business, what is recovered is value, and the word keeps its accounting sense of making the balance whole again.
senses.whyCN: 在商业中，追回的是价值，这个词保留了让账目重新平衡的会计含义。

senses.title: To regain control of oneself
senses.definition: to become calm and controlled again after strong emotion
senses.definitionCN: 在强烈情绪之后重新变得平静自持
senses.example: He recovered himself and continued speaking.
senses.exampleCN: 他镇定下来，继续发言。
senses.why: To recover oneself is to get one's own composure back, as if composure were a thing that had slipped away.
senses.whyCN: 「恢复自己」就是把镇定取回来，仿佛镇定是一件滑走的东西。

intro.en: Recover is a Latin verb of regaining that came through French, and its image of getting something back covers health, wealth, and composure.
intro.cn: recover 是经法语传来的拉丁语「重新获得」动词，其「取回」的形象覆盖健康、财富与镇定。

items.en: Recuperare meant to regain or recover, especially what had been lost.
items.cn: recuperare 意为重新获得或收回，尤指失去之物。

items.en: Recuperatio named the act of regaining, the noun behind recovery.
items.cn: recuperatio 指重新获得的行为，是 recovery 背后的名词。

items.en: Old French recovrer carried the verb into English with its broad sense intact.
items.cn: 古法语 recovrer 把这个动词带入英语，宽泛含义完好保留。

items.en: Middle English recoveren covered health, property, and composure.
items.cn: 中古英语 recoveren 已涵盖健康、财产与镇定。

items.en: Modern English extended the verb to markets, data, and personal calm.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个动词扩展到市场、数据与个人平静。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs beginning with re-; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of healing and regaining.
note.cn: 形近组收以 re- 开头的动词；近义组收表治愈与重新获得的动词。

entries.definition: To cover something again.
To move back suddenly.
To tell a story in detail.
To become healthy again.
To get something back.
To bring something back.
To recover health and strength.

normalIntro.en: The word is getting back: health, things, money, and calm are all things that can be lost and regained.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「取回」：健康、物品、金钱与平静，都是可能失去又能重新得到的东西。

normal.en: Re plus cover: to get back what was taken away.
normal.cn: re 加 cover：把被拿走的东西重新取回。

normal.en: Recover from illness, recover losses, recover oneself: one verb, many returns.
normal.cn: recover from illness、recover losses、recover oneself：一个动词，多种「回来」。

normal.en: Recovered is the past form: recover, recovered, recovering.
normal.cn: 过去式是 recovered：recover、recovered、recovering。

normal.en: Fully recover means to return to complete health.
normal.cn: fully recover 意为完全恢复健康。

normal.en: Do not confuse recover with re-cover, which means cover again.
normal.cn: 不要把 recover 与 re-cover 混淆，后者意为重新覆盖。

abstract.en: Recovery is not the absence of loss but the refusal to stay lost.
abstract.cn: 恢复不是没有失去，而是拒绝停留在失去里。

abstract.en: What a person recovers from shows what that person can survive.
abstract.cn: 一个人从什么中恢复过来，显示出他能承受什么。

abstract.en: To recover oneself is the quietest and hardest recovery of all.
abstract.cn: 恢复镇定，是最安静也最艰难的一种恢复。

examples.en: He slowly recovered from the operation.
examples.cn: 他在手术后慢慢康复。

examples.en: She recovered her lost keys from the sofa.
examples.cn: 她从沙发里找回了丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: The company recovered most of its losses.
examples.cn: 这家公司追回了大部分损失。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）加 cover（取得）：把失去的东西重新取回，就是 recover——康复、找回、恢复都由「取回」而来。

root: 拉丁 recuperare（重新获得）→ 古法语 recovrer → 中古英语 recoveren → 英语 recover；同族有 recovery、recoverable。

sensesIntro.en: The core is getting back what was lost; the senses move from health to a former state, lost objects, money, and composure.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「把失去的取回」；义项从健康，到原有状态、失物、金钱，再到镇定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a patient's hand on the bed rail, feet reaching the floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：病人的手扶住床沿，双脚落到地上。

branches.en: a first step from a sickbed
branches.cn: 从病床上迈出的第一步

branches.en: a market rising after a fall
branches.cn: 下跌后回升的市场

branches.en: keys found under a cushion
branches.cn: 在坐垫下找到的钥匙

branches.en: money returned to a ledger
branches.cn: 记回账上的钱

branches.en: a speaker finding his voice again
branches.cn: 重新找回声音的发言者

intro.en: A Latin verb of regaining passes through French, and its noun and adjective offspring name the process and the possibility.
intro.cn: 一个表「重新获得」的拉丁动词经法语传来，其名词与形容词后代分别命名过程与可能性。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is recuperare, to regain, with the noun recuperatio behind recovery.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 recuperare（重新获得），其名词 recuperatio 是 recovery 的来源。

items.meaning: in the process of getting back

definition_zh: 重新创造；再现；使振作（旧义）
definition_en: to make a thing again, to bring an event back before the eyes, or, in older use, to refresh a person
core_image: 烧毁的街景照着唯一一张照片，一间一间重新搭起来
scene: 剧场的布景烧毁之后，工匠照着照片把整条街重新搭了起来。The stage crew recreated the whole street from a single photograph.
sceneCN: 这里 recreate 指重新创造、重建（第 1 个义项：把被毁的东西再做一遍）；句意为布景烧毁之后，工匠照着一张照片把整条街重新搭起来。

senses.title: To recreate a lost thing
senses.definition: to make again something that has been destroyed or discontinued
senses.definitionCN: 把已被毁掉或中断的东西重新做出来
senses.example: The stage crew recreated the whole street from a single photograph.
senses.exampleCN: 舞台工作人员照着一张照片把整条街重新搭了出来。
senses.why: The first sense is about manufacture: the thing did not exist, now it does.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项讲的是制作：东西原本不存在了，现在又存在。

senses.title: To recreate the past
senses.definition: to make a past event happen again in front of an audience or a mind
senses.definitionCN: 让过去的事件在观众或头脑面前再发生一次
senses.example: The film recreates the first crossing in careful detail.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影细致地再现了第一次横渡。
senses.why: Here nothing material is remade; only the appearance returns.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项里没有实物被重造，回来的只是景象。

senses.title: To recreate oneself
senses.definition: in older use, to refresh the spirits of a tired person
senses.definitionCN: 在旧用法中，指让疲惫的人恢复精神
senses.example: A walk by the river recreated him after the long hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的听证之后，沿河散步让他恢复了些精神。
senses.why: This sense has its own pronunciation and its own history.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项有自己的读音，也有自己的历史。

intro.en: Recreate comes from Latin recreare, 'to make anew or restore', from re- and creare, 'to bring forth'.
intro.cn: recreate 来自拉丁语 recreare（重新造出、恢复），由 re- 加 creare（产生）构成。

items.en: Creare meant to make or bring forth.
items.cn: creare 意为制造、产生。

items.en: The compound meant both to make again and to restore.
items.cn: 这个复合词既指重新制造，也指恢复。

items.en: The hyphen kept the plain sense of making again.
items.cn: 带连字符的写法保留「重新制造」的本义。

items.en: The older verb also meant to restore a person's spirits.
items.cn: 这个较早的动词也指恢复人的精神。

items.en: Dictionaries now separate recreate from re-create.
items.cn: 现代词典把 recreate 与 re-create 分开。

note.en: The look-alike group is the create- family; the near-meaning group separates rebuild, reproduce, restore and refresh.
note.cn: 形近组是 create 词族；近义组把「重建」「复制再现」「修复」「提神」分开。

entries.definition: to create again, spelled with a hyphen.
entries.definitionCN: 再次创造，带连字符书写。

entries.definition: the act of making again, or leisure.
tending to refresh.
one who makes something again.
to build again after damage.
to present again as a copy.
to bring back a former condition.
to make someone feel new energy.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a burnt street rebuilt from one surviving photograph.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条烧毁的街，靠一张幸存的照片重新搭起来」的画面。

normal.en: Recreate is re plus create: the making happens a second time.
normal.cn: recreate 是 re 加 create：制造发生第二次。

normal.en: Picture one photograph pinned to the wall of a ruined street.
normal.cn: 想象废墟的墙上钉着唯一一张照片。

normal.en: Say ree-KREE-ayt for the making sense, REK-ree-ayt for the old one.
normal.cn: 表示「再造」读 ree-KREE-ayt，旧义读 REK-ree-ayt。

normal.en: The word can rebuild a wall or only a memory of one.
normal.cn: 这个词可以重建一堵墙，也可以只重建关于墙的记忆。

normal.en: Ask whether the copy is meant to fool the eye or serve the use.
normal.cn: 问这个复制品是要骗过眼睛，还是要真的能用。

abstract.en: To recreate is to trust that a form can outlive its material.
abstract.cn: 重新创造就是相信形式能比材料活得更久。

abstract.en: Every reconstruction chooses what to leave out of the past.
abstract.cn: 每一次重建都在选择把过去的哪部分删掉。

abstract.en: The old refresh sense reminds us that people, too, are remade.
abstract.cn: 那个古老的「提神」义提醒我们，人也是被重造的。

examples.en: The stage crew recreated the whole street from a single photograph.
examples.cn: 舞台工作人员照着一张照片把整条街重新搭了出来。

examples.en: The film recreates the first crossing in careful detail.
examples.cn: 这部电影细致地再现了第一次横渡。

examples.en: A walk by the river recreated him after the long hearing.
examples.cn: 漫长的听证之后，沿河散步让他恢复了些精神。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ create（创造）→ 把已经没了的东西再做一遍。

root: 拉丁语 recreare（重新造出、恢复）→ re- + creare（产生）

sensesIntro.en: Three senses remake three different things: a lost object, a past event, and a tired person's spirits.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项重造的是三样不同的东西：失去的实物、过去的事件，以及疲惫者的精神。

core.en: ONE PHOTOGRAPH REBUILT IN WOOD
core.cn: 照着一张照片重搭的街

branches.en: A material thing made again.
branches.cn: 被重新做出的实物。

branches.en: An event staged again for the eyes.
branches.cn: 为眼睛再演一次的事件。

branches.en: A tired person's spirits restored.
branches.cn: 疲惫者的精神被恢复。

branches.en: One rebuilds the object, the other rebuilds its appearance.
branches.cn: 一个重造物体，一个重造它的外观。

branches.en: Both restore something that had run out.
branches.cn: 两者都恢复某种已经耗尽的东西。

intro.en: The create- family is about bringing forth: create, creation, creator, recreative and recreation all keep that root.
intro.cn: create 词族讲的是「产生」：create、creation、creator、recreative、recreation 都保留这个词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin creare, 'to bring forth', gives creation; the re- in recreare adds a second bringing forth or a restoring.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 creare（产生）给出 creation；recreare 里的 re- 加上第二次产生，或一次恢复。

definition_zh: 消遣；休养；再创作
definition_en: enjoyable activity that refreshes the mind or body; the restoring of health; the act of creating again
core_image: 公园长椅上的人放下工作，笑着望向湖面
scene: 周末的公园里，有人骑车，有人铺开野餐布。Gardening is his favourite form of recreation.
sceneCN: 这里 recreation 是「消遣」（第 1 个义项：让人放松的娱乐活动）；句意为园艺是他最喜欢的消遣。画面里可留意：骑车的人、铺开的野餐布。

senses.title: Enjoyable activity
senses.definition: an activity done for enjoyment that refreshes the mind or body
senses.definitionCN: 为获得乐趣、使身心恢复而做的事
senses.example: Gardening is his favourite form of recreation.
senses.exampleCN: 园艺是他最喜欢的消遣。
senses.why: Recreare meant to restore, and the noun first named the restoring of health before it named the games that do the restoring.
senses.whyCN: recreare 意为恢复，这个名词先指恢复健康，后来才指带来恢复的娱乐活动。

senses.title: The restoring of strength
senses.definition: the act of recovering strength and health after work or illness
senses.definitionCN: 在工作或生病之后恢复体力与健康的行为
senses.example: He walked by the sea for recreation after the illness.
senses.exampleCN: 病后他在海边散步休养。
senses.why: The older sense is recovery, and a walk taken to restore the body keeps that meaning alive.
senses.whyCN: 较早的意思是恢复，而为了调养身体所走的散步，正是这层含义的延续。

senses.title: The act of creating again
senses.definition: the act of making something again or of reproducing a scene or an event
senses.definitionCN: 重新制作某物，或再现某个场景与事件
senses.example: The film is a recreation of the battle rather than a record.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片是对那场战役的再现，而不是记录。
senses.why: When re- is read as again and create as to make, the word can literally mean a second making.
senses.whyCN: 当 re- 被读作「再次」、create 被读作「制作」时，这个词就可以字面地表示「第二次制作」。

intro.en: Recreation begins as restoration: the body is made fresh again, and the activities that do this take the name.
intro.cn: recreation 始于「恢复」：身体被重新造得清新，而带来这种效果的活动便沿用了这个名字。

items.en: Creare meant to create, produce, or bring forth, the root of the family.
items.cn: creare 意为创造、产生或带来，是整个词族的词根。

items.en: Recreare joined re-, again, to creare and meant to restore or refresh.
items.cn: recreare 由 re-（再次）与 creare 组成，意为恢复或使清新。

items.en: Old French recreacion carried the noun into English as refreshment.
items.cn: 古法语 recreacion 把这个名词带入英语，意为恢复精神。

items.en: English first used recreation for the restoring of health after labour.
items.cn: 英语最初用 recreation 指劳作之后的恢复。

items.en: Modern English widened the word to the games and hobbies that refresh people.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个词扩展到使人恢复的游戏与爱好。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns from the same create family; the near-meaning group gathers words for leisure and amusement.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 create 词族的名词；近义组收表休闲与娱乐的词。

entries.definition: The act of making something new.
A response to an event.
The act of making something again.
Free time used for enjoyment.
Activity that amuses people.
A hobby that passes the time pleasantly.
The state of being entertained.

normalIntro.en: The word is creating again: energy that was used up is made fresh, and the activity that does it is called recreation.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「重新创造」：耗掉的精力被重新造出，而做这件事的活动就叫 recreation。

normal.en: Re plus creation: a second making, this time of your own strength.
normal.cn: re 加 creation：第二次创造，这次造的是你自己的精力。

normal.en: Outdoor recreation means games played in the open air.
normal.cn: outdoor recreation 指在户外进行的活动。

normal.en: A recreation centre is a building for leisure activities.
normal.cn: recreation centre 是供休闲活动的场所。

normal.en: Recreation and re-creation differ by a hyphen and by their meaning.
normal.cn: recreation 与 re-creation 只差一个连字符，意思却不同。

normal.en: The noun is uncountable when it means leisure, countable when it means a re-enactment.
normal.cn: 表休闲时不可数，表「再现」时可数。

abstract.en: Recreation is the art of making the self fresh again.
abstract.cn: 消遣是让自我重新清新的艺术。

abstract.en: What restores a person is not idleness but a different kind of effort.
abstract.cn: 让人恢复的不是闲散，而是另一种努力。

abstract.en: A society shows its values in what it chooses to do for recreation.
abstract.cn: 一个社会选择以什么为消遣，就显露出它的价值。

examples.en: Gardening is his favourite form of recreation.
examples.cn: 园艺是他最喜欢的消遣。

examples.en: He walked by the sea for recreation after the illness.
examples.cn: 病后他在海边散步休养。

examples.en: The film is a recreation of the battle rather than a record.
examples.cn: 这部影片是对那场战役的再现，而不是记录。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（重新）加 create（创造）：把耗掉的精力重新造回来，就是休养；用来休养的活动，就是消遣。

root: 拉丁 creare（创造）→ recreare（恢复、重新振作）→ 古法语 recreacion → 英语 recreation；同族有 recreational、recreate。

sensesIntro.en: The core is restoration; the senses move from restoring health to the activities that restore it and to a second making of a scene.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「恢复」；义项从恢复健康，到带来恢复的活动，再到对场景的再次制作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a park bench where someone sets down their work and smiles at the lake.
core.cn: 核心意象：公园长椅上的人放下工作，笑着望向湖面。

branches.en: a picnic blanket on grass
branches.cn: 草地上铺开的野餐布

branches.en: a slow walk by the sea
branches.cn: 海边缓慢的散步

branches.en: a film set rebuilding a battle
branches.cn: 重建战役场景的片场

branches.en: a game and the strength it restores
branches.cn: 游戏与它恢复的精力

branches.en: a body remade and a scene remade
branches.cn: 身体被重建，场景也被重建

intro.en: A Latin verb of creating takes a prefix of repetition and a noun ending, and the result names both rest and re-enactment.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「创造」动词接上表重复的前缀与名词词尾，结果既指休息，也指再现。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is creare, to create, changed by re- and named by -tio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 creare（创造），由 re- 加以改变，并由 -tio 名词化。

definition_zh: 娱乐的；休闲的；消遣用的
definition_en: relating to recreation; used for leisure; taken for pleasure rather than medical need
core_image: 湖边一排彩色的脚踏船和自行车
scene: 湖边租船处排着一排彩色的脚踏船，孩子们在挑颜色。The town opened a new recreational area beside the lake.
sceneCN: 这里 recreational 是「休闲的」（第 2 个义项：供休闲使用的）；句意为小镇在湖边新开了一片休闲区。画面里可留意：彩色的脚踏船、挑颜色的孩子。

pos.zh: 娱乐的；休闲的；消遣用的

senses.title: Relating to enjoyable activity
senses.definition: connected with activities done for enjoyment
senses.definitionCN: 与为乐趣而做的活动有关
senses.example: Swimming is a recreational sport for most people.
senses.exampleCN: 对大多数人来说，游泳是一项娱乐性运动。
senses.why: The adjective simply attaches the noun recreation to whatever serves it, so any game played for fun is recreational.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是把名词 recreation 连接到为它服务的事物上，因此任何为乐趣而玩的游戏都是 recreational。

senses.title: Used for leisure
senses.definition: built or set aside for leisure rather than work
senses.definitionCN: 为休闲而非工作而建造或留出的
senses.example: The town opened a new recreational area beside the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 小镇在湖边新开了一片休闲区。
senses.why: A place marked off for pleasure takes the adjective, because its purpose is the restoring of people.
senses.whyCN: 一块为快乐而划出的地方会带上这个形容词，因为它的目的是让人恢复。

senses.title: Taken for pleasure
senses.definition: used for enjoyment rather than for medical treatment
senses.definitionCN: 为享乐而非治疗而使用
senses.example: The law separates recreational use from medical use.
senses.exampleCN: 法律把消遣性使用与医疗使用区分开来。
senses.why: When a substance is taken for pleasure rather than health, the same adjective marks the difference.
senses.whyCN: 当某种物质是为快乐而非健康而使用时，正是同一个形容词标记出这一区别。

intro.en: Recreational is the noun of leisure with an adjective ending: everything that serves refreshment takes the label.
intro.cn: recreational 是表休闲的名词加形容词词尾：一切为恢复服务的事物都带上这个标签。

items.en: Creare meant to create or produce, the root of the family.
items.cn: creare 意为创造或产生，是词族的词根。

items.en: Recreare meant to restore or refresh a tired body.
items.cn: recreare 意为恢复或使疲惫的身体清新。

items.en: English recreation named both restoration and leisure activity.
items.cn: 英语 recreation 既指恢复，也指休闲活动。

items.en: The suffix -al means relating to, giving recreational.
items.cn: 后缀 -al 意为「与……有关的」，由此构成 recreational。

items.en: Modern English applies the adjective to places, sports, and casual drug use.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个形容词用于场所、运动与消遣性用药。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers adjectives with similar endings; the near-meaning group gathers words of leisure and pleasure.
note.cn: 形近组收结尾相似的形容词；近义组收表休闲与乐趣的词。

entries.definition: Good at producing new ideas.
Responding to a stimulus.
Something newly made.
Free time for enjoyment.
Giving enjoyment.
Relaxed and not serious.
Not used as medicine.

normalIntro.en: The word is recreation plus al: anything that serves leisure carries the label.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 recreation 加 al：凡为休闲服务的事物，都带上这个标签。

normal.en: Recreation plus -al: relating to leisure.
normal.cn: recreation 加 -al：与休闲有关。

normal.en: A recreational area is land set aside for play.
normal.cn: recreational area 是为玩乐留出的地方。

normal.en: Recreational facilities include pools, courts, and trails.
normal.cn: recreational facilities 包括泳池、球场与步道。

normal.en: The stress stays on the third syllable, as in recreation.
normal.cn: 重音仍在第三音节，与 recreation 一致。

normal.en: Recreational use of a drug means use for pleasure, not treatment.
normal.cn: 药物的 recreational use 指为享乐而非治疗而使用。

abstract.en: A recreational space is a city admitting that people need more than work.
abstract.cn: 休闲空间，是一座城市承认人需要的不仅是工作。

abstract.en: Play labelled recreational is play that society permits itself.
abstract.cn: 被标为休闲的玩乐，是社会允许自己拥有的玩乐。

abstract.en: The adjective turns pleasure into a category of planning.
abstract.cn: 这个形容词把快乐变成了规划中的一个类别。

examples.en: Swimming is a recreational sport for most people.
examples.cn: 对大多数人来说，游泳是一项娱乐性运动。

examples.en: The town opened a new recreational area beside the lake.
examples.cn: 小镇在湖边新开了一片休闲区。

examples.en: The law separates recreational use from medical use.
examples.cn: 法律把消遣性使用与医疗使用区分开来。

dict_mnemonic.text: recreation（消遣）加 al（……的）：与消遣有关的，就是 recreational——娱乐的、休闲的。

root: recreation（消遣）+ 后缀 -al（……的）→ recreational；recreation 源自拉丁 recreare；同族有 recreationally。

sensesIntro.en: The core is serving refreshment; the senses move from enjoyable activity to leisure places and to pleasure use.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「为恢复服务」；义项从娱乐活动，到休闲场所，再到消遣性使用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of bright paddle boats waiting at a lakeside jetty.
core.cn: 核心意象：湖边码头旁排着一排色彩鲜亮的脚踏船。

branches.en: a swimmer in a public pool
branches.cn: 公共泳池里的游泳者

branches.en: a new park by the lake
branches.cn: 湖边新建的公园

branches.en: a pleasure taken without a prescription
branches.cn: 不凭处方取用的享乐

branches.en: a game and a place built for it
branches.cn: 游戏与为它建造的场所

branches.en: a leisure area and a leisure choice
branches.cn: 休闲场所与休闲选择

intro.en: A noun of leisure takes a Latin adjective ending, and the adjective spreads from sports to places to casual use.
intro.cn: 一个表休闲的名词接上拉丁形容词词尾，这个形容词便从运动扩展到场所，再到消遣性使用。

latinIntro.en: The base is recreare, to refresh, and the ending -al marks a relation.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 recreare（使恢复），词尾 -al 标记关联。

definition_zh: 招募；招收；新兵；新成员
definition_en: to enlist new soldiers or members; to take someone into a company or team; a newly enlisted person
core_image: 军营门口排起长队，年轻人在登记表上写下名字
scene: 军营门口排起长队，年轻人把名字写进登记表。The army began to recruit soldiers from the surrounding villages.
sceneCN: 这里 recruit 是「招募」（第 1 个义项：征募新兵）；句意为军队开始从周边村庄招募士兵。画面里可留意：门口的长队、写名字的登记表。

senses.title: To enlist soldiers
senses.definition: to persuade people to join an army or a fighting force
senses.definitionCN: 说服人们加入军队或武装力量
senses.example: The army began to recruit soldiers from the surrounding villages.
senses.exampleCN: 军队开始从周边村庄招募士兵。
senses.why: The Latin root meant to grow again, and a recruit is new growth added to an army that needs more men.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「再次生长」，而新兵就是为一支缺人的军队补充的新生力量。

senses.title: To take someone into a team
senses.definition: to bring a person into a company, a club, or a sports team
senses.definitionCN: 把某人招进公司、俱乐部或运动队
senses.example: The firm recruited three engineers this spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司今年春天招了三名工程师。
senses.why: The military sense widened to any group that adds members, because every team also needs new growth.
senses.whyCN: 军事义扩展到任何补充成员的团体，因为每个团队也都需要新的生长。

senses.title: A newly enlisted person
senses.definition: a person who has just joined an army, a company, or a team
senses.definitionCN: 刚加入军队、公司或团队的人
senses.example: The new recruits trained for six weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 新兵们训练了六周。
senses.why: The noun names the new growth itself, the person who has just been added to the body.
senses.whyCN: 名词指「新生力量」本身，也就是刚被加入集体的人。

intro.en: Recruit is about growth: an army that needs men is made to grow again, and the new men are the growth.
intro.cn: recruit 讲的是生长：缺人的军队被重新养大，而新人就是那份生长。

items.en: Crescere meant to grow, the root behind the whole family.
items.cn: crescere 意为生长，是整个词族的词根。

items.en: Recrescere meant to grow again, to increase after a loss.
items.cn: recrescere 意为再次生长，在损失之后重新增加。

items.en: French recrute named a new growth of troops, a fresh supply of soldiers.
items.cn: 法语 recrute 指军队的新生力量，即新补充的兵员。

items.en: English recruit first meant to repair an army by adding men.
items.cn: 英语 recruit 最初指通过补充人员来修复军队。

items.en: Modern English extended the verb to hiring in companies and clubs.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个动词扩展到公司与俱乐部的招聘。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short verbs beginning with re-; the near-meaning group gathers words for enlisting and newcomers.
note.cn: 形近组收以 re- 开头的短动词；近义组收表征募与新来者的词。

entries.definition: To get back money spent.
To tell a story in detail.
To lean back.
To join or sign up an army.
To employ someone.
To call people into service.
A person who has just arrived.

normalIntro.en: The word is growing again: an army short of men is made to grow, and the men are the growth.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「再次生长」：缺人的军队被重新养大，而新人就是那份生长。

normal.en: Re plus cruit: grow the force again, and you recruit.
normal.cn: re 加 cruit：让队伍再次生长，就是招募。

normal.en: A new recruit is the person added, not the act of adding.
normal.cn: new recruit 指被加入的人，而不是加入的行为。

normal.en: Recruit staff is the business use; recruit soldiers is the military one.
normal.cn: recruit staff 是商业用法，recruit soldiers 是军事用法。

normal.en: Recruited is the past form: recruit, recruited, recruiting.
normal.cn: 过去式是 recruited：recruit、recruited、recruiting。

normal.en: A recruiter is the person who does the recruiting.
normal.cn: recruiter 是做招募这件事的人。

abstract.en: Every group that survives knows how to grow again.
abstract.cn: 每一个能存续的团体，都懂得如何再次生长。

abstract.en: A recruit brings energy that the old members have used up.
abstract.cn: 新人带来的是老成员已经耗尽的能量。

abstract.en: To recruit is to bet that a stranger will become one of us.
abstract.cn: 招募，就是赌一个陌生人会成为我们中的一员。

examples.en: The army began to recruit soldiers from the surrounding villages.
examples.cn: 军队开始从周边村庄招募士兵。

examples.en: The firm recruited three engineers this spring.
examples.cn: 这家公司今年春天招了三名工程师。

examples.en: The new recruits trained for six weeks.
examples.cn: 新兵们训练了六周。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）加 cruit（生长）：让队伍再长出新人，就是招募；被招来的人就是新兵。

root: 拉丁 crescere（生长）→ recrescere（再生长）→ 法语 recrute → 英语 recruit；同族有 recruitment、recruiter。

sensesIntro.en: The core is new growth added to a group; the senses move from enlisting soldiers to hiring members and to the person added.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「为团体补充的新生力量」；义项从征募士兵，到招收成员，再到被加入的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a queue at a barracks gate, names written on a list.
core.cn: 核心意象：军营门口排起长队，名字被写进名册。

branches.en: a queue at a barracks gate
branches.cn: 军营门口的长队

branches.en: three desks filled at a company
branches.cn: 公司里坐满的三张桌子

branches.en: a line of new soldiers training
branches.cn: 一列训练中的新兵

branches.en: an army and an office both growing
branches.cn: 军队与公司都在生长

branches.en: hiring and then training
branches.cn: 先招进来，再加以训练

intro.en: A Latin verb of growing takes a prefix of repetition, passes through French, and then covers armies and offices.
intro.cn: 一个表生长的拉丁动词接上表重复的前缀，经法语传来，随后覆盖军队与公司。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is crescere, to grow, strengthened by re- into recrescere.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 crescere（生长），由 re- 加强为 recrescere。

definition_zh: 矩形；长方形；长方形的一片区域
definition_en: a four-sided figure with four right angles, or a rectangular patch of something
core_image: 黑板上一块被粉笔框出的方形，正好把地图的一角圈在里面
scene: 他用粉笔在地图上把两座城镇框进同一个方形里。He drew a rectangle around the two towns on the map.
sceneCN: 这里 rectangle 指矩形（第 1 个义项：四个直角的四边形）；句意为他用粉笔在地图上画了一个矩形，把两座城镇圈在里面。

pos.zh: 矩形；长方形；长方形区域

senses.title: A geometric rectangle
senses.definition: a plane figure with four straight sides and four right angles
senses.definitionCN: 有四条直边和四个直角的平面图形
senses.example: He drew a rectangle around the two towns on the map.
senses.exampleCN: 他在地图上画了一个矩形，把两座城镇框在里面。
senses.why: The first sense is exact: geometry fixes the angles and the sides.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是精确的：几何学规定了角与边。

senses.title: A rectangle of light
senses.definition: a rectangular patch or area of a surface, light or colour
senses.definitionCN: 表面、光或颜色上呈长方形的一片
senses.example: A rectangle of sunlight lay across the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 一片长方形的阳光横铺在地板上。
senses.why: No angle is measured here; the eye simply sees a long block of light.
senses.whyCN: 这里并不测量角度，眼睛只是看到一块长条形的光。

intro.en: Rectangle comes from Latin rectangulus, 'having right angles', from rectus, 'straight', and angulus, 'angle'.
intro.cn: rectangle 来自拉丁语 rectangulus（有直角的），由 rectus（直的）与 angulus（角）构成。

items.en: Rectus meant straight or right.
items.cn: rectus 意为直的、正的。

items.en: Angulus meant a corner or an angle.
items.cn: angulus 意为角、拐角。

items.en: The compound named a figure with right angles.
items.cn: 这个复合词指有直角的图形。

items.en: French shortened the word into rectangle.
items.cn: 法语把它缩短成 rectangle。

items.en: English kept it for the four-sided figure.
items.cn: 英语用它指这种四边形。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rect- family, which shares the root of straightness; the near-meaning group separates square, oblong, quadrilateral and parallelogram.
note.cn: 形近组是 rect 词族，共享「直」的词根；近义组把「正方形」「长椭圆形／长方形」「四边形」「平行四边形」分开。

entries.definition: shaped with right angles.
to make straight or correct.
moral straightness.
the lower end of the bowel.
a rectangle with equal sides.
a rectangle longer than it is wide.
any four-sided figure.
a four-sided figure with parallel opposite sides.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a chalk box drawn on a map around two towns.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「在地图上用粉笔框住两座城镇的方框」的画面。

normal.en: Rectangle is rect plus angle: four right angles make the name.
normal.cn: rectangle 是 rect 加 angle：四个直角造出了这个名字。

normal.en: Picture the chalk line closing on itself.
normal.cn: 想象那道粉笔线自己合拢起来。

normal.en: Say REK-tang-gl; the hard g closes the word.
normal.cn: 读 REK-tang-gl，末尾的硬 g 收住词音。

normal.en: A square is only the strictest rectangle.
normal.cn: 正方形只是最严格的那个矩形。

normal.en: The word can describe a figure, a field or a patch of light.
normal.cn: 这个词能描述图形、田地，也能描述一片光。

abstract.en: A rectangle is agreement made visible: two pairs of sides consent to be parallel.
abstract.cn: 矩形是看得见的约定：两对边同意保持平行。

abstract.en: The shape is the simplest way to hold an area still.
abstract.cn: 这个形状是把一片面积固定下来的最简单办法。

abstract.en: Chalk rectangles are how people make the world countable.
abstract.cn: 粉笔画的矩形是人把世界变得可数的方式。

examples.en: He drew a rectangle around the two towns on the map.
examples.cn: 他在地图上画了一个矩形，把两座城镇框在里面。

examples.en: A rectangle of sunlight lay across the floor.
examples.cn: 一片长方形的阳光横铺在地板上。

examples.en: The garden was laid out as a long rectangle.
examples.cn: 那座园子被布置成一个窄长的矩形。

dict_mnemonic.text: rect（直）+ angle（角）→ 四个角都是直角的四边形。

root: 拉丁语 rectangulus（有直角的）→ rectus（直的）+ angulus（角）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses: the exact figure of geometry, and any long block the eye picks out on a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项：几何学里那个精确的图形，以及眼睛在表面上看出的任何一块长条。

core.en: A CHALK BOX CLOSED ON ITSELF
core.cn: 自己合拢的粉笔方框

branches.en: The measured figure with four right angles.
branches.cn: 四个直角、可以测量的图形。

branches.en: A block of light or colour on a surface.
branches.cn: 表面上的一块光或一块颜色。

branches.en: One is proved, the other merely seen.
branches.cn: 一个被证明，一个只是被看见。

branches.en: Geometry keeps the sides straight.
branches.cn: 几何学要求边是直的。

branches.en: The eye keeps only the outline.
branches.cn: 眼睛只保留轮廓。

intro.en: The rect- family is about straightness: rectus gives rectangle, rectify, rectitude and rectilinear the same spine.
intro.cn: rect 词族讲的是「直」：rectus 给 rectangle、rectify、rectitude、rectilinear 同一根脊梁。

latinIntro.en: Latin rectus, 'straight', joins angulus, 'angle', to make rectangulus; the figure is literally a right-angled thing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rectus（直）与 angulus（角）合成 rectangulus；这个图形字面上就是「有直角的東西」。
